description: [PAID $0.001 USDC per call via x402 on Base; errors are free] Live crypto prices for up to 25 coins per call: pass tickers in `symbols` (BTC,ETH,SOL,AERO,...; common tickers built in, others resolved by CoinGecko search to the largest coin with that ticker), CoinGecko `ids`, or one token `address` + `chain` (base default; ethereum, arbitrum, optimism, polygon, bsc, avalanche, solana). Returns price, market cap, 24h volume and 24h % change in each `vs` currency (usd default; up to 5, e.g. usd,eur,btc) plus last-updated time. Data: CoinGecko public API, cached 30 s; falls back to Coinbase spot rates (price only) if CoinGecko is unavailable. All params optional: with none it returns BTC and ETH in USD. Unknown coins = 404, invalid input = 400, never charged.

address.description: Optional token contract address; returns that token price (overrides symbols/ids).

ids.description: Comma-separated CoinGecko coin ids, e.g. bitcoin,aerodrome-finance (optional).

symbols.description: Comma-separated tickers, e.g. BTC,ETH,SOL (max 25). Optional: defaults to BTC,ETH.

vs.description: Comma-separated quote currencies (max 5), e.g. usd,eur,btc. Default usd.

name: crypto_price
title: Crypto prices (ticker, id or contract)
